confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, and beer anchors use aggregated Marrakech price data. Cocktail prices vary by venue and draw on limited current data; the wine-glass estimate uses its local price relationship to beer. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates and vary substantially by season, location, and property.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Marrakech's own city-level food and drink price data, with accommodation estimated from general knowledge of Moroccan tourist-city pricing and Marrakech's strong visitor demand.
